meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自查并单审已完成工作，核验目标、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你刚完成功能开发，想在提交PR前做一次独立的把关审查。
copy.tagline_en: Gate-check completed work with a single reviewer before handoff.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just finished coding and want an independent check before a PR handoff.

howto.what: 请它审查已完成工作时,它不只读代码,而会先自己在真实运行环境跑功能测试(正常、边界、回归),有失败立刻报“审查失败”;通过后才派一个评审子代理,对照原始目标、约束、代码质量、安全性、漏掉的上下文和测试证据核对,双关都过才给“通过”。
howto.when: 准备把 PR 交接出去之前,或你明确要求“审查已完成的工作”时触发;通常由一次 review 请求开启。

say.text: 我刚写完这次改动,请你帮我 review 一下。
say.note: Claude 会先自己跑功能测试,再派一个评审代理把关。

say.text: 新功能准备提 PR 了,先帮我做一次门禁审查。
say.note: 应用无法启动或测试有失败时会当场报失败。

say.text: 审查这次改动:对照目标、约束和安全要求查漏。
say.note: 只有测试矩阵无失败行且评审代理批复才认定为通过。

howto.what_en: Claude runs real functional checks itself; a failing row aborts with REVIEW FAILED. If green, one gate-reviewer subagent audits goal, constraints, code, security, missing context, and QA evidence, and returns a single PASS/FAIL verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to review already-completed work, or right before handing a PR over. Typically started by a review request after implementation finishes.

say_en.text: Please review the work I just finished — run your QA first, then a gate review.
I'm about to hand this PR over — run the gate review before I do.
say_en.note: If the app can't start, it reports failure immediately and skips further review.

say_en.text: Audit these changes against the stated goal, constraints, and security concerns.
say_en.note: It passes only when every QA row is green and the gate reviewer approves.
